item.title: [AI:product | CRITICAL 9.2] CVE-2026-112136
item.description: A vulnerability has been identified in Mendix Studio Pro 11 (All versions >= V11.15.0 = V11.12.6 < V11.12.7). The affected products MCP Server does not properly restrict its HTTP listener to the loopback interface, leaving it potentially exposed to remote systems. This could allow an attacker with network access to interact with the MCP Server remotely.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 7.7] CVE-2026-125368
item.description: OmniAgent through commit 12b98c5 contains an approval bypass vulnerability in ReflexionAgent._is_safe_bash_command that treats any command starting with find as safe without inspecting -execdir arguments. Prompt-injected agents can run find with -execdir to invoke binaries like dd, nc, perl or openssl through an unsandboxed shell, overwriting files or executing code without human approval.
